1.consolidated_definition: Gran cantidad. Un chorrete de gente, un chorrete de ideas. El presidente ejecutivo de Ambac Financial, Nader Tavakoli, aseguró ayer que la quiebra del gobierno sería catastrófica… completamente catastrófica para los chorretes de ricos que compraron bonos de Puerto Rico a centavos por cada dólar del precio original ….
1.en_consolidated_definition: A large quantity. A bunch of people, a bunch of ideas. The executive president of Ambac Financial, Nader Tavakoli, stated yesterday that the government's bankruptcy would be catastrophic... completely catastrophic for the bunches of wealthy individuals who purchased Puerto Rico bonds at pennies per dollar of the original price....
